verses.1: See how much love our Father has given us, so that we might be called children of God. And because of this, the world does not understand that we do not know Him at all.
verses.2: Beloved ones, now we are the children of God. And it has been revealed what we will become. We know that if we become like Him, then we will see Him as He truly is.
verses.3: And everyone who has this hope in themselves will be considered holy, just as that holy being is.
verses.4: Everyone who commits sin and injustice also commits shame. And sin is indeed injustice.
verses.5: And you know that he was revealed there so that he could forgive people’s sins. And sin doesn’t exist in him at all.
verses.6: Anyone who resides in it does not sin. But anyone who sins does not recognize him, nor knows him at all.
verses.7: Children, no one will deceive you. He who acts justly is indeed just, just as that person is also just.
verses.8: The one who causes sin to arise from within is the devil. From the beginning, the devil has been responsible for causing sin. This is why the Son of God came into the world in order to resolve the problems caused by the devil.
verses.9: Every person who is born from God does not commit sin, because his seed remains within him. He also cannot sin, because he was born from God.
verses.10: In this, it becomes clear that the children of God are different from those of the devil. Anyone who does not practice justice is not truly belonging to God. And anyone who does not love their brother is also not worthy of being called a true child of God.
verses.11: For this is the message you have heard from the beginning: to love one another.
verses.12: He wasn’t like Caius, who was evil from birth. So why did he harm his brother? It’s because his own actions were evil, while those of his brother were just.
verses.13: Do not marvel, brothers, if the world hates you.
verses.14: We know that we have been raised from death to life. We love our brothers. Those who do not love remain in death.
verses.15: Every person who hates his brother is a murderer. And you know that every murderer does not have eternal life in them.
verses.16: In this, we have recognized true love—that he gave his own soul for us. And we owe it to our brothers to also give their souls for them.
verses.17: How can he who has lived a life in this world and considers his brother to be worthy of respect, still close his eyes to him? How can the love of God remain in him?
verses.18: Children, we should not love words or language alone, but rather in actions and truth.
verses.19: In this, we will understand that it comes from the truth. And before that, we must convince our hearts.
verses.20: Because if our hearts are truly attentive, then God, who is the ruler of our hearts, will know everything.
verses.21: Beloved ones, if our hearts do not follow God’s will, then we must submit ourselves to God’s authority.
verses.22: And if we ask for it, we will receive from him that he obey his commands and do what is pleasing to him.
verses.23: And this is also his command: that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, just as he commanded us to do.
verses.24: And he keeps the commands of God within himself. In this way, we understand that He remains with us, through the Spirit who has given us these commands.
